**CustomAchievements 1.10.0** — for Paper 1.21.4 (Java 21). Drop the jar into
your server's `plugins/` folder. New config options are merged into your
existing `config.yml` automatically on first startup.

### Added
- **Achievements now credit what you'd already done before they existed.** Add a
  "kill 200 players" achievement to a server where someone already has 150 kills
  and they start at **150/200**, not 0. Every objective is seeded from
  Minecraft's own lifetime statistics — on join, and the moment a new
  achievement is saved.

  Seeded: blocks mined and placed, items crafted and picked up, mobs and players
  killed (whole mob families are summed), fish caught, and deaths. Start at zero
  as before, because the server keeps no statistic for them: custom item names,
  a death with a specific cause, `ITEM_HAVE`, locations, dimensions, MythicMobs
  and AuraSkills.

  Each objective is seeded once per player and seeding never lowers progress, so
  this never double-counts — and since that's tracked per player rather than
  inferred from "has no progress yet", testing a new achievement by going and
  scoring a kill doesn't cost you the kills you already had. Toggle with
  `backfill-from-statistics` (default `true`).

  ⚠️ On a long-running server, players may immediately complete achievements
  they had already earned the statistics for, which pays out rewards and fires
  broadcasts. Set the option to `false` if you'd rather everyone started fresh.

- **Deaths can now require a cause.** `PLAYER_DEATH` used to count *any* death;
  its target now narrows how you died:

  | Target | Means |
  | --- | --- |
  | `ANY` (or unset) | Any death at all |
  | `LAVA`, `FALL`, `DROWNING`, `VOID`, `FREEZE`, … | A specific damage cause |
  | `CREEPER`, `ZOMBIE`, `PLAYER`, … | Killed by that mob |
  | `#HOSTILE`, `#UNDEAD`, `#BOSSES`, … | Killed by any mob in that family |

  Cause and killer are both checked, because the damage cause of a creeper kill
  is only `ENTITY_EXPLOSION` — the mob has to be matched on its own. Arrows and
  other projectiles resolve to whoever fired them, so a skeleton's arrow counts
  as a skeleton kill. Existing death objectives are unaffected: an unset target
  (or `ANY`) still counts every death.

- **`ITEM_HAVE` trigger — "have X of an item right now".** A live count of the
  player's inventory rather than a running total, so it sees items that arrive
  with no event at all: `/give`, plugin grants, creative mode. Like the other
  item triggers it can match a **custom item name** instead of a material —
  flip "Match by: Custom Name" in the objective editor — which is the usual way
  to track a named quest item or currency.

### Changed
- **`ITEM_OBTAIN` now counts items taken out of containers**, not just items
  picked up off the ground. Chests, barrels, furnace output, villager trades and
  loot all count toward it now. Rearranging your own inventory or crafting grid
  still doesn't, and neither does clicking through this plugin's own menus.

### Which item trigger do I want?

- **`ITEM_OBTAIN`** — a running total of items received. Never goes down when
  you spend them. Can't see `/give`.
- **`ITEM_HAVE`** — how many you're holding right now. Catches every source
  including `/give`, but drops if you spend or store them. Once the objective is
  completed the achievement is awarded for good.
